thread:
Aisha (partnerships): quick sync — partner wants an early sandbox run. NDA outstanding, they want a 2-week bench window next month and tentative joint demo/press. Who can own NDA, lab slotting, telemetry, and press gating?
Tom (eng): I can own bench infra and run scripts. need lab slot + access creds. :+1:
Mia (hw-ops): lab slots look tight. I have a 2-node bench cluster free week of Apr 19, then backlogged. Could do Apr 19-30 window.
Aisha (partnerships): perfect, @Mia please pencil Apr 19 start. partner asked for sampled telemetry + token-level traces (privacy-safe).
Eva (legal): I can triage the NDA today — send the partner copy with our standard EAP addendum. If there are redlines, please flag. ETA end of day Thursday.
Tom (eng): bench plan draft attached (quick paste):
```
bench-plan:
- model: rdx-v1-preview
- runs/day: 8 concurrent short/2 long
- metrics: latency p50/p95, throughput, OOMs, mem, perf-regressions
- artifacts: logs -> s3://redwood-eap/partner/xxxxx
```
Mia (hw-ops): telemetry hook: we'll create a temporary S3 bucket and an IAM role. sampling at 1% token-level; scrub PII. I can wire it to the infra account.
Aisha (partnerships): partner also asked about press/announcement timing — they proposed an embargoed demo after the bench window. we should avoid committing until bench results and legal ok.
Tom (eng): agree. also want to run a quick smoke on their inputs first day, avoid noisy runs.
Eva (legal): once NDA done I can add an embargo clause to the EAP addendum. also need to confirm data handling (no customer data on their side).
DeployBot: deployment scheduled: create-temp-bucket -> created at 3171234620, role: redwood-eap-role-3171.
Mia (hw-ops): confirmed bucket + role. I'll share creds privately.
Aisha (partnerships): action items: @Eva NDA by Thu EOD; @Mia lab slot Apr 19 and creds; @Tom bench infra and smoke test day1; I'll own partner comms and press hold.
Tom (eng): I'll prep runbook and share commands, example: `./run_bench.sh --profile eap --out s3://redwood-eap/partner/xxxxx`
Eva (legal): if partner redlines within 48h we'll escalate. sending initial copy now.
Aisha (partnerships): ok closing thread — tentatively bench window Apr 19-30, embargoed demo only after bench + legal signoff. please update if anything slips. :memo:
Mia (hw-ops): :thumbsup: noted and blocked nodes.
Tom (eng): noted, will post runbook link in the morning.
Eva (legal): NDA sent 3171234635, will update thread when signed.
Aisha (partnerships): thanks team, will ping partner with tentative schedule after Eva confirms NDA status.
